request:
Pass native agent option values through without allowlisting

## Problem

GitWeave currently validates provider-native option values against hard-coded allowlists.

Examples include:

- Codex `sandbox` values
- Claude `permission_mode` values

This makes GitWeave an authority on which native CLI values are valid. If Codex or Claude adds or changes a supported value, GitWeave can reject it before the native CLI has a chance to evaluate it.

That is unnecessary policy for a thin orchestration runtime.

## Expected outcome

Treat provider-native option values as pass-through configuration.

GitWeave should validate only what it needs for its own graph contract, such as:

- the option is present only on the relevant provider/node type
- the value is a string when the native CLI expects a string

Do not maintain hard-coded allowlists of native CLI option values unless a concrete GitWeave correctness requirement requires one.

Pass explicit values through unchanged and let the underlying Codex or Claude CLI accept or reject them.

Conceptually:

```text
Graph native option
  ↓
GitWeave passes value through
  ↓
Codex / Claude validates it
```

## Context

The guiding principle is:

> GitWeave should not duplicate provider-native validation when the provider CLI already owns that contract.

This keeps GitWeave compatible with newly added native modes without requiring runtime changes first.


User directive: GitWeave implements, creates a separate PR, reviews/fixes iteratively and merges only when clean. Stop on unsupported operations or permission/allowance limits and ask the user. No parent manual substitute is authorized.
